text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Shambala] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ and -3000 DP until their turn ends.
[Your Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a [TB] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -2: Lv.4 or lower [TB] trait card

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [TB] trait Digimon card with 5000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.

qa.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
qa.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
During an attack by this card, I used its [Your Turn] effect to digivolve it. Does this card's [End of Attack] inherited effect trigger at the end of the attack?

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Hybrid]/[Shambala]/[TS] trait: Cost 5

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Hybrid] Form.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -9: 8 [Hybrid]/[Shambala] trait cards w/different names

qa.answer:
No, you cannot.
As this card has left the battle area, it doesn't have digivolution cards whose colors could be determined. Thus, the effect cannot be processed.
qa.question:
When I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect and my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area due to processing the 1st part, an immediate-type effect such as "when [...] would leave" removes this card from the battle area.
After that, can I process the part of the effect following after "then" in this card's effect?
